# S352 — Accept slicer relay v12 and read its tool_feedback line

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

slicer s453 landed on 2026-11-12: RELAY_CONTRACT is 12, adding an optional `tool feedback` run-report line (at most 3 entries, counted toward 30 lines): `tool feedback: N. ROLE | tool: slicer|ork|NAME | kind: friction|feature|deterministic-check | proposal: TEXT | evidence: TEXT`, or `tool feedback: none`; `slicer ai relay --json` gains a `tool_feedback` key after `conformance` and `report.lines` a `tool_feedback` key before `role_steps`. Because `slicer` on PATH is an editable install of slicer's main, ork now refuses every relay: `ork doctor` fails the contract check for all 12 projects ("ork accepts relay v10 or v11 and slicer prints v12"), and the slicer v1.22 wave is paused at s457/s459. Wanted: accept v12 (and v11 for pinned projects), carry role tool feedback into ork's run view/needs-you, never act on it in the slice.
